newsitem.title: UK: Sunderland football share offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Sunderland football share offer oversubscribed.

text.p: Sunderland Plc, the northeast English premier league football club in the throes of a flotation, said on Friday that its share offer had been oversubscribed.

At 1200 GMT on December 19, the closing date for acceptances, 3,008 applications had been received in respect of 923,700 ordinary shares -- 2.7 times the number of shares available. Sunderland plans to raise 10.7 million stg, with an offer price set at 585 pence per share.

Bob Murray, chairman, said "I am delighted to be able to report that Sunderland Plc's offer for subscription has been well received by our supporters and the public and I am pleased they will be able to participate in the growth of the club as we enter an exciting new era.
Sunderland said it will use the new funds to add finishing touches to a new 15 million stg stadium, cut back on borrowing and buy new players.
